Note of the author
Download 5 Coolvetica styles free for commercial use under the Typodermic Desktop License: Coolvetica Regular, Coolvetica Italic, Coolvetica Condensed Regular, Coolvetica Compressed Regular, and Coolvetica Crammed Regular.

Coolvetica is tightly spaced display typography made for headlines, product names, logos, and short campaign phrases. The free selection covers regular, italic, condensed, compressed, and extremely narrow forms, giving designers several ways to keep its crisp custom-lettered snap across packaging, posters, branding, and social graphics.

The license lets one licensed user install the fonts on desktop or laptop computers and use them at no charge in commercial and non-commercial finished work. This covers logos, branding, advertising, print, packaging, merchandise, fixed website graphics, presentations, title cards, and rendered video when the delivered result contains no font software or reusable character set.

Font embedding and font-file sharing are not covered. Webfonts, apps, games, software, devices, servers, SaaS, editable templates, cloud design platforms, personalization systems, and commercial ebooks or PDFs containing embedded font software require another license or written permission. Pre-rendered static graphics inside those products are permitted when they contain no working font or reusable characters. Read the Typodermic license guide for details.

These free styles are part of the larger Coolvetica family. Explore the complete Coolvetica family for more styles and wider licensing options.
